blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Local stocks dropped sharply on Thursday due to rising expectations of interest rate hikes in the U.S. and domestically, alongside foreign fund withdrawals. market. The benchmark Philippine Stock Exchange Index (PSEi) dropped 2.20 percent, or 126.30 points, to close at 5,610.39. READ: PH inflation shock revives bets on BSP rate hikes Philstocks Financial Inc. attributed the decline to mounting concerns over tighter monetary policy from both the US Federal Reserve and the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP).
